Ah, that changes things. If production and staging have separate configurations now, then you can't assume the variable was copied over just because it works locally.

You'll need to check the production environment configuration directly—either by looking at the deployment template/config for production itself, or by checking what's actually set in the running production environment. The variable may not be set there at all, or it might have a different value than what you're using locally.

Have you checked the production deployment config or tried to verify what the actual value is in production?
